title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency on RBAC v2 policies and improve audit logging for cross-region key usage. No runtime behavioral changes for customers who already have KMS_region set. Admins must review new policy validation alerting.
description: Motivation: Close gaps discovered during SOC2 readiness review and a recent customer audit where cross-region KMS key bindings were not consistently enforced by RBAC v2. This PR hardens RBAC v2 validation to enforce KMS region residency constraints, augments audit logs with explicit key residency fields, and adds migration checks/tools for existing policies. Summary of changes: 1) Add 'kms_region' constraint to RBAC v2 schema and validation path, 2) Enforce residency during policy creation/update (audit-only mode flag available), 3) Emit structured audit fields (kms_key_id, kms_key_region, policy_id, decision) for all key operations, 4) Add Linear hooks and monitoring rules to detect policy bypass patterns, 5) Migration tool to scan existing policies and produce remediation suggestions (linear tickets), 6) Tests and e2e validations for Dedicated and Private deployments. Backwards compatibility: New schema field is optional. By default we enable 'audit-only' enforcement for 2 weeks post-merge, then flip to enforced mode via feature flag/rollout. Admins with org:admin can opt-in earlier. Impact: Customers using cross-region keys without explicit residency spec will continue to work during audit-only window but will be alerted with remediation guidance. Full enforcement will reject policy changes that allow cross-region keys without residency being set. Implementation notes: The validation logic is implemented in rbac/v2/validator.go and rbac/v2/schema_v2.yaml. Audit enhancements live in services/audit/logger.go and observability/metrics/audit_rules.prom. Migration scanner is a CLI under tools/policy-scanner that outputs suggested edits and a CSV. Security review: design reviewed with Priya Nair and Evan Zhang; cryptography and KMS integration design reviewed with Cloud Security. Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main (audit-only enabled), 2) Run migration scanner company-wide and create linear tickets for policy owners, 3) Monitor new audit metrics for 2 weeks, 4) Flip enforcement via feature flag and notify customers. Related work: ENG-4210 (RBAC v2 hardening), SEC-998 (KMS residency requirements).

review_conversation: Jordan Lee (reviewer): Overall looks good. Need to ensure validator fallbacks gracefully when KMS metadata service is temporarily unavailable. Please add retry/backoff and a safe default (audit-only).
Aisha Patel (author): Added retry with exponential backoff and cache TTL. Validator now defaults to audit-only decision when KMS metadata fails after retries.
Priya Nair (security): Please ensure audit events include both key ARN and parsed region for downstream SIEM correlation. Also add unit tests covering malformed key metadata.
Aisha Patel (author): Included key_arn and key_region fields in audit events and added tests for malformed metadata. Updated docs with SIEM mapping notes.
Evan Zhang (approver): Verified logic in staging with sample policies and KMS stubs. Approving with comment: ensure rollout flag path is gated by release manager and a bake period of 14 days.
Release Manager (comment): Noted; will coordinate flip to enforced mode after 14-day observation window and migration ticketing.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for validator error paths, integration tests exercising KMS metadata responses (ok, missing, malformed), e2e test that simulates audit-only window and then enforcement. Ran full test matrix on Dedicated and Private templates. Policy-scanner validated against a snapshot of 2k policies and produced 142 suggestions.
migration_notes: tools/policy-scanner outputs CSV with columns: policy_id, org_id, current_kms_key, key_region_detected, suggested_action. We ran scanner as dry-run and created Linear tickets for top 50 high-risk policies. Admins should run scanner before enforcement and remediate or explicitly opt-in to cross-region policies.
monitoring_and_rollout: New metrics: audit.kms.residency.alerts, audit.kms.residency.enforcement.decisions (allowed/rejected/audit-only). Dashboards added to Redwood Console under Security -> RBAC Residency. Rollout: audit-only for 14 days, then flip enforcement via feature flag per-region with monitoring alerts and rollback runbook.
